**Archived at Zenodo:** [doi:10.5281/zenodo.24168353](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24168353). This DOI always resolves to the latest release of the maintained version.

## Summary

`errata.qmd` lists 14 entries. Entries 5 and 6 are notes on coauthored claims that await the authors. The other 12 are corrections to the text, labels, one table, and the references. The rerun rests on the deposit at Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/LBPTEK, which `download_original.R` fetches and checks file by file against `original_manifest.csv`. `run_all.R` reads nothing else, so anyone can rerun it. This repository has no independent rewrite, which falls short of Stage 3: every computed value comes from the deposit's own code and estimators, apart from the repaired one-sided test.

## What was run

`maintained/run_archive.R` runs `r n_distinct(status$script)` scripts twice in scratch copies, records each run in `ground_truth/archive_run_status.csv`, and records the files each pass wrote in `ground_truth/archive_overwrites.csv`. Every script exits 0 on both passes, as deposited and stripped. What the logs show:

- `table_C5` writes to `../replication_archive/`. The first harness's scratch name caused that failure, so it was not an archive defect, and the scratch copy now has that name.
- `figure_5`, `figure_7`, and `figure_C8` call `format_num` or `make_se_entry`, exported by `rdss`, and `figure_C8` calls `ggstance`'s `position_dodgev`. In the authors' archive none of the three attached those packages, so all three failed. The deposit adds both `library()` calls, and the three now run clean.
- `figure_A4` logs an error and exits 0. The script's comment says such errors are caught and handled, and the error is inside its `try()` around bootstrap draws.

The five shipped estimate files are rebuilt on the stripped pass, with a largest numeric difference below 6e-13. `r sum(rebuilt$matches_deposit)` of the five match the shipped files outright; the other `r sum(!rebuilt$matches_deposit)`, the two `hypotheticals_study` files, label the treatment "Pro-Democratic hypotheticals" where the shipped files read "Pro-Democrat hypotheticals". Two files in `maintained/output/` were measured once on the authors' raw exports, which hold IP addresses and coordinates and are not deposited, so the script that wrote them is not in this repository. Run on those exports, the project's two cleaning scripts rebuild the four cleaned hypothetical files with no differing shared column (`raw_to_clean.csv`), and the exports' start dates give the fielding months entry 8 uses (`fielding_months.csv`). That test does not reach the survey experiments or the field experiment, whose cleaned files are inputs here.

## The deposit

The replication archive is deposited at Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/LBPTEK, released 2026-11-12. The deposit is the authors' final archive of 2025-12-29 with six of its 39 files changed. `clean_field_experiments.rds` loses the voter-file identifier and the demographic, district, and household-size columns, and `clean_survey_experiments.rds` loses the survey start timestamps; no script reads any of them. `figure_5`, `figure_7`, and `figure_C8` gain `library(rdss)` and `library(ggstance)`. `README.txt` records those changes. The other 33 files are byte-identical to the archive.

## Checks and what they do not cover

- **Prose values.** `ground_truth/build_ground_truth.R` compares 56 claims with the rerun at the page's precision. The mismatches are the spine's. These compare the page with the deposit's own data, so a defect both inherit would pass.
- **Claims script.** `maintained/in_text_claims.R` scores each extracted claim with `excheckr`: a claim a quantity erratum names must equal the corrected value, and every other claim must match the page. It reads the same `page_values.csv` as the ground truth, so it ties the errata to the rerun rather than checking each value by a second path.
- **Float coverage.** `ground_truth/float_coverage.csv` lists the 24 floats with the numbers each prints and the quantities each figure plots. No float is rebuilt, and `covered` counts the prose claims that restate a number a float prints.
- **Negative controls.** `ground_truth/negative_controls.R` tests that the gate fires on those faults only.
- **Page checks.** Every quote was read on a rendered crop of its key clause, and Figure 2 on the page. The rest of each sentence-long quote rests on the text layer.
- **Crossref.** Family names and years were compared for most article references. The service rate-limited 13 of 48 and 11 were not parsed, mostly books. Only Goren and Chapp was rechecked singly, so the reference list is not fully checked.

## Not done

- No figure other than Figure 2 was read against its rerun, so the labels of Figures 1 and 3 to 7 are unchecked, though their prose values are in the gate. No table cell outside Table A.2 and the Table B.3 label was compared.
- The appendix prose was searched by known phrases and not read whole. The Table A.1 change made for the journal's replicator was not rechecked.
- Study 4's added Table A.2 cells rest on a subtraction, since its `video_all` does not name the video.
- The page proofs in `QJPS page proofs/` were not compared, so entry 13's hyphenation may be the typesetter's rather than the authors'.
- Queue rows 13 to 15 and 65 are answered: entries 5 and 6 stay in note form, the archive is deposited, and row 65 names the columns that left it first.
